verses.gurmukhi: ਰੇਣਿ ਰਸਾਇਣ ਸਿਝੀਐ ਰੇਤੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਵਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: ren rasain sijheeaai ret het kar ka(n)chan vasai|

en.bdb: The dust of sand in which remains gold mixed is kept in a chemical.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਕਣੁ ਕਢੀਐ ਰਤੀ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲਾ ਹਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhoi dhoi kan kaddeeaai ratee maasaa tolaa hasai|

en.bdb: Then after washing the gold particles are taken out of it which weigh from miligrams to grams and more.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਕੁਠਾਲੀ ਗਾਲੀਐ ਰੈਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਨਿਆਰਿ ਵਿਗਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: pai kuThaalee gaaleeaai rainee kar suniaar vigasai|

en.bdb: Then put into the crucible it is melted and to the delight of the goldsmith, is converted into lumps.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੜਿ ਘੜਿ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪਖਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਲੂਣੀ ਲਾਇ ਜਲਾਇ ਰਹਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: ghaR ghaR patr pakhaaleean loonee lai jalai rahasai|

en.bdb: He makes leaves out of it and using chemicals washes it happily.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਵੰਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਲਗੈ ਲਵੈ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਕਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: baareh va(n)nee hoi kai lagai lavai kasauTee kasai|

en.bdb: Then transformed into pure gold it becomes nimble and worthy of the test by touchstone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਟਕਸਾਲੈ ਸਿਕਾ ਪਵੈ ਘਣ ਅਹਰਣਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਚਲੁ ਸਰਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: Takasaalai sikaa pavai ghan aharan vich achal sarasai|

en.bdb: Now in the mint, it is moulded into a coin and remains happy on the anvil even under the strokes of hammer.
Then becoming pure muhar, a gold coin, it gets deposited into treasury i.e.the gold which was in the dust particles because of its humility, ultimately turns out to be a coin of the treasure house.
